newsitem.title: UK: US stocks in London mixed, high-techs inch ahead.
newsitem.headline: US stocks in London mixed, high-techs inch ahead.

text.p: U.S. shares were mixed in cautious trade on Thursday as interest rate worries and continued weakness on Wall Street kept many European investors on the sidelines.
U.S treasuries were little changed from overnight levels as players awaited Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's scheduled testimony on the U.S. economy later on Thursday.
"Greenspan isn't likely to say anything new but the market is so nervous at the moment that if he sneezes, we could see the market come off," one dealer said.
Greenspan will testify before the Congressional Joint Economic Committee at 1500 GMT/1000 EST, his last scheduled public address before next week's Federal Open Market Committee meeting on March 25.
